{{dablink|For other uses of the word "road," see [[Road]].}}
The '''Jehannah Road''' is a road in [[Ghealdan]] that connects [[Jehannah]] and [[Andor]]. [[Perrin Aybara]] was planning on traveling through it before a group of travelers informed his men that were traveling ahead that the road was too muddy to be able to travel through with carts.{{Ref/book|13|2}}
